H2s: what super is, opening an account, when you can get it back (conditions plus 'what if your visa is still valid'), checking whether the employer pays, finding and combining funds, step-by-step online claim (7 steps) and paper claim with form NAT 7204, 'Kann ich nach Superauszahlung wieder nach Australien?', 'Superannuation und Tax Return nicht verwechseln', 4 FAQs. Tax refund page that ranks for the cluster and mentions super as part of the refund topic; shows that German searchers mix up Steuerrückerstattung and Super, which our FAQ already separates.

Official source (English, updated 24 Aug 2026): eligibility, free online system that covers fund and ATO-held super and can be started before leaving, paper forms NAT 7204 and NAT 74880, 5,000 $ threshold, 28-day service standard, WHM rate table (65 % on taxed and untaxed element, nil on tax-free component), 6-month transfer rule, payment options (international transfer only for applications to funds).

gap_summary: Nobody in German has an answer-first summary, a dated key-figures block with official sources, or a clear 'online or paper, which form' explanation. The best German competitor covers more sub-topics (applying before departure, payment abroad, returning to Australia, costs), and our page has three small factual drifts against the ATO page (28 days counted from approval instead of from the complete application, '6 months after visa expiry' instead of '6 months after departure with the visa ceased', and 'can be paid to a foreign account' without the ATO-held exception).

changes.new_text:
Der übliche Weg ist das kostenlose DASP-Online-System des ATO. Es deckt Super ab, die noch beim Fonds liegt, und Super, die der Fonds schon an das ATO übertragen hat, und es prüft deinen Visumstatus direkt beim Department of Home Affairs. Anlegen und speichern kannst du den Antrag schon in Australien, absenden erst nach der Ausreise.

Auf Papier gibt es zwei Formulare: NAT 7204 schickst du an jeden Fonds einzeln, NAT 74880 an das ATO für Guthaben, die dort liegen. Papieranträge an das ATO kosten nichts, ein Fonds kann für Papieranträge je nach Guthaben eine Gebühr verlangen. Ab 5.000 $ kommt bei Papier oft die Certification of Immigration Status (Formular 1194) dazu, die Home Affairs nur gegen Gebühr ausstellt.

Quelle: ATO, Departing Australia superannuation payment
changes.why: 'DASP beantragen' is a target query, and the best German competitor wins on 'wie stelle ich den Antrag' with the form numbers. This explains the channels and forms (facts, form numbers, costs from the ATO) without the click-by-click walkthrough the page deliberately avoids (see the howToSchema comment). It also makes the visible outbound link to ato.gov.au, a trust signal for both Google and AI answers.

Facts come only from llms.txt Key facts and the ATO and Home Affairs URLs below.

facts.fact: DASP eligibility: super built up on a temporary resident visa (not 405/410), visa ceased (expired or cancelled), left Australia and holding no other active Australian visa, not an Australian or NZ citizen or permanent resident.

The online DASP application system is free, covers super held by a fund and super held by the ATO, checks immigration status with Home Affairs, and can be started and saved in Australia but submitted only after departure with no active visa.
ATO: 'It may be difficult for you to start the process once you have left' and certifying documents is easier while in Australia.

Paper forms: NAT 7204 sent to each super fund; NAT 74880 for ATO-held super, sent to the ATO. No cost for paper applications to the ATO; funds may charge a fee for paper applications based on the balance.

Balances of 5,000 $ or more: the fund may require certified copies of ID documents; paper applications may require a Certification of Immigration Status (Form 1194), which has a fee. Under 5,000 $ (paper): evidence of departure and visa expiry can be given instead.
Service standard: 28 days from when the completed application is lodged; longer if incomplete or more documents are requested.

WHM DASP rates: tax-free component nil, taxable taxed element 65 %, taxable untaxed element 65 % (non-WHM: 35 % and 45 %). The WHM rate applies to the whole DASP if it includes contributions made while on a 417 or 462 visa or an associated bridging visa.
DASP withholding rate for working holiday makers 65 % of the taxable component, effective 1 July 2017.
Unclaimed super is transferred by the fund to the ATO when it has been 6 months or more since leaving Australia and the visa has ceased; it can still be claimed as a DASP.
Payment options: EFT to an Australian bank account, Australian dollar cheque, or international money transfer, the latter only for applications to super funds.
DASP is not assessable income; final tax is withheld, so neither the DASP nor the tax withheld goes in the tax return.
The ATO DASP page states no time limit for claiming (page updated 24 August 2026).
Employer super does not depend on the visa (as long as there are work rights) or tax residency status.
Superannuation Guarantee 12 % of ordinary time earnings since 1 July 2025; from 1 July 2026 Payday Super requires most employers to pay within days of each payday.
Online DASP application system entry point
Paper form NAT 7204 and NAT 74880 pages
